name: Meinhardt
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">

  <RD format_version="3">
  
    <description>
      Hans Meinhardt's five-chemical model for producing stripes.
      
      Meinhardt, Hans (1982) "Models of Biological Pattern Formation"<br>
      <a href="http://www.eb.tuebingen.mpg.de/research/emeriti/hans-meinhardt/82-book/bur82.html">book available to download</a>
      
      Based on Greg Turk's implementation: <a href="http://www.cc.gatech.edu/~turk/reaction_diffusion/reaction_diffusion.html">link</a>
    </description>
    
    <rule name="Meinhardt" type="formula" wrap="0" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
    
      <param name="timestep">    0.2       </param>
      <param name="k_ab">        0.04      </param>
      <param name="k_c">         0.06      </param>
      <param name="k_de">        0.04      </param>
      <param name="diff1">       0.005     </param>
      <param name="diff2">       0.4       </param>
      
      <formula number_of_chemicals="5">
        delta_a = diff1 * laplacian_a + 0.01f * a * a * e / c - a * k_ab;
        delta_b = diff1 * laplacian_b + 0.01f * b * b * d / c - b * k_ab;
        delta_c = 0.01f * a * a * e + 0.01f * b * b * d - c * k_c;
        delta_d = diff2 * laplacian_d + (a - d) * k_de;
        delta_e = diff2 * laplacian_e + (b - e) * k_de;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
    
        <!-- a = k_c / (2*k_ab) -->
        <overlay chemical="a">
            <overwrite />
            <parameter name="k_c" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="a">
            <divide />
            <constant value="2" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="a">
            <divide />
            <parameter name="k_ab" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        
        <!-- b = a -->
        <overlay chemical="b">
            <overwrite />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        
        <!-- c = 0.02*a*a*a/k_c -->
        <overlay chemical="c">
            <overwrite />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="c">
            <multiply />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="c">
            <multiply />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="c">
            <divide />
            <parameter name="k_c" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        <overlay chemical="c">
            <multiply />
            <constant value="0.02" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        
        <!-- d = a -->
        <overlay chemical="d">
            <overwrite />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        
        <!-- e = a -->
        <overlay chemical="e">
            <overwrite />
            <other_chemical chemical="a" />
            <everywhere />
        </overlay>
        
        <!-- add a seed pattern -->
        <overlay chemical="a">
            <overwrite />
            <!--<constant value="0.5" />-->
            <white_noise low="0.5" high="1" />
            <circle radius="0.05" >
              <point3d x="0.2" y="0.4" z="0.4" />
            </circle>
            <circle radius="0.05" >
              <point3d x="0.3" y="0.8" z="0.4" />
            </circle>
            <rectangle>
              <point3d x="0.95" y="0" z="0" />
              <point3d x="1" y="1" z="1" />
            </rectangle>
        </overlay>
        
    </initial_pattern_generator>

    <render_settings>
        <low value="0" />
        <high value="1.5" />
        <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0" />
        <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1" />
        <show_multiple_chemicals value="true" />
        <show_color_scale value="false" />
        <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
        <timesteps_per_render value="32" />
        <phase_plot_x_axis value="a" />
        <phase_plot_y_axis value="d" />
        <phase_plot_z_axis value="c" />
    </render_settings>
       
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
